description: This file contains SQL code for configuring Row Level Security (RLS) policies in a PostgreSQL database for a multi-tenant application. It defines session parameter helpers, enables RLS on various tables, and establishes permissions policies for organizations, memberships, projects, tasks, and user information, based on user roles and organizational relationships.

methods.name: app.current_user_id()
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the current user based on session settings.

methods.name: app.current_org_id()
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the current organization based on session settings.
